description: This file contains the TasksController class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing tasks in a task management system. The controller supports actions such as listing all tasks, retrieving a task by ID, creating, updating, and deleting tasks. It utilizes dependency injection for the task service and applies authorization attributes.

classes.name: TasksController
classes.description: API controller for task management, exposes CRUD endpoints for tasks.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves and returns all tasks asynchronously.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific task by its GUID ID asynchronously.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new task based on provided DTO and returns the created task.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing task identified by GUID with provided DTO.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a task by its GUID ID.
